limits: ACS estimates are 2019–2023, not a 2028 population forecast.
Detailed-origin CVAP, registration and issue opinions are modeled, not observed.
Legacy religion and faction-alignment values have unverified provenance; union is a resident-population scenario share rather than a worker-membership rate.
Connecticut medians omitted; count MOEs use square-sum approximation.
Alaska borough electoral priors use the historical workbook where available; district-coded 2024 rows are not borough results.
